label: heart100-s3
summary: The model predicts heart disease (training AUC 0.952) mostly through an additive backbone of direct edges; switching the backbone off lowers training AUC to 0.523. In it, high resting blood pressure, a flat ST segment, coloured vessels, male sex and asymptomatic chest pain raise predicted risk, and a normal thallium scan and a higher peak heart rate lower it. The hidden parts correct the backbone (switched off together, training AUC falls to 0.918): a blood-pressure brake makes pressure count mainly up to a threshold, which is lower with an upsloping ST segment; an exercise-reserve chain adds risk that grows with age for patients with a reassuring exercise test, so the gap between a flat and an upsloping segment shrinks with age; an age hinge from about 61 years turns whole-model risk down for older patients; an ST-depression hinge adds risk past 0.4 mm; an atypical-angina switch lowers risk; and a gate adds risk for combinations of atypical angina, a downsloping segment and women with several coloured vessels. Structural and compositional coverage are complete, and the annotated model reproduces the original to within 3.3e-16.

resisted: Resisted: not applicable at the level of parts. Two behaviours are worth checking: for the typical patient, predicted risk falls from 38% at 0 mm to 21% at 2 mm of ST depression before rising, and a normal fasting blood sugar carries a positive direct weight (0.33 per sd). The age hinge lowers risk for older patients whose observed outcome rate (55.9%) is higher than that of the 106 patients from their fifties up to the hinge (49.1%); it is a counterweight to age terms elsewhere, not a protective effect.

Scope words: 'no direct edge' for ST depression (hidden_unit_terms) rests on the direct-edge list in q_832303e085, which has no oldpeak edge; the gate rule's agreement is a training-row count (q_a2ced4d037, 0 disagreements) plus constructed-case probes, not a full enumeration. tool_bugs: query_enumerate refuses any genome with a continuous input (age has 41 values), even with a where clause, so the gate rule was checked on the training rows with query_subgroup (gate vs rule disagreement count) and on constructed cases with two-sweep query_probe grids instead; query_probe allows at most two sweeps. get_formula returns no provenance id, so formula evidence carries the LaTeX payload and cites check_explanation for the tolerance. add_evidence has no allow_numbers argument, so a narrative with a literal (an age bound, a thallium code) had to be reworded. rename_inputs leaves a trailing space on each display name in its printout (cosmetic).
